measurements.evidence_quote: Tables S1–S3 summarize the zeta potentials of PNPs, porous media, and hydrodynamic diameters (dp) of PNPs under all experimental conditions. || The zeta potentials and hydrodynamic diameters of PNPs were also measured using the ZetaSizer.
Table S3 shows that the zeta potentials of PNPs and porous media under IS = 1 mM with the mixture of 0.3 mM Na2HPO4 and 0.1 mM NaCl were more negative than those of 1 mM NaCl.
